overall.verdict: The mobile-light variant of xln wallet demonstrates strong fintech design principles with excellent visceral value representation and trust cues. However, there are opportunities to reduce visual noise and improve readability of secondary information.
priority_fixes: Reduce visual noise by lightening or removing redundant headers (BALANCES, RECEIPT)
Improve readability of small text elements (scale, optional labels, truncated hashes)
Condense space-consuming elements (route display, color legend, scale examples)
Enhance trust perception by showing full proof hashes and counterparty names
Refine typography consistency across all screens
